review.reviewer_model: /root/recovery_review; inherited host model, exact backend identifier not independently exposed

confidence.basis: Exact updated source/aggregate hashes, direct original-to-patch comparison, reused unchanged stdlib handshake/thread analysis, and static inspection of the added download timeout and real slow-reader regression. Approval permits bounded queued validation and, after its success, the declared source-only deployment canary with original sealed-artifact retry. Neither the new four-test result nor corrected external readback is yet measured by this review; it is not completed availability, delivery, artifact-retention or formal-experiment readiness certification.

review_limitations: Static fallback after same-session external review route exhaustion; actual checks recorded separately
No generic DoS/thread-quota certification; original300s PUT timeout and keepalive behavior preserved

measured_unit.scope: Production HTTPS main in subprocess: stalled TLS/header acceptance, idle expiry, auth/namespace/immutable upload, slow reader backpressure
